acceptance_gate.condition: real_factual_corpus_built == true AND corpus_non_degenerate == true AND n_examples >= 200
acceptance_gate.principle: A facts re-measurement is only meaningful on a real, non-degenerate, adequately-sized corpus -- a degenerate or tiny corpus repeats the .335/.330 limitation.

field_principles.class_balance: Both classes >= 20% -- guards against the imbalance that made the .335 code corpus fragile.
field_principles.confidence_baseline_auroc: The bar the grounding verifier must beat downstream; MUST be < 0.95 (a perfect confidence baseline = degenerate corpus, exp3574).
field_principles.corpus_non_degenerate: True iff confidence AUROC < 0.95 AND class balance ok -- a degenerate corpus cannot test the facts hypothesis.
field_principles.corpus_path: Where the real corpus lives -- the provenance for exp3670.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: builds + baselines a cached corpus; no FoVer LLM load).
field_principles.n_examples: Sample-size rigor (>=200 for a percentage-point AUROC claim downstream).
field_principles.real_factual_corpus_built: BARE bool. True iff a real, non-degenerate, schema-valid corpus was persisted. STORE AS BARE true/false -- gates exp3670.
field_principles.source_benchmark: RAGTruth / FELM / HaluEval + version -- external-benchmark provenance (the whole point: real, not synthetic).

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: builds + baselines a cached corpus; no FoVer LLM load).
